title: Tensor surjectivity detects a negative valuation
statement: Let A be a subring of a field K with fraction field K, let B be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] with fraction field K and normalized valuation v:K^\times\to\mathbf Z, and assume the canonical map A\otimes B\to K is surjective. Then there exists a nonzero x\in A with v(x)<0.
